what: Each wordmark letter is folded at its lower-left hinge (offset 40%·20%, tilted 20°, turned Y 100°·X −30°, .8x, nearly transparent), and once it enters the lower 25% of the screen it unfolds from .58s, each letter .08s later than the last, over 1s with cubic-bezier(.27,0,.58,1) — a logo whose letters stand up one by one like paper. To time it yourself, as with loaders or heroes, set when: manual and add is-in

options.[data-fx-part=char]: (if present) letter cells — if absent, the part splits the text into cells. A logo symbol (svg) added as one cell unfolds together with them
options.at: Share subtracted from the bottom of the screen (IntersectionObserver rootMargin bottom), default -25%
options.when: With manual, no look is applied — the user sets the class="is-in" Expands when attached (Hero after the loader)
options.again: When on, keeps watching even after unfolding once (default is once)
options.--fx-dur · --fx-back · --fx-ease: Expand duration (default 1s) · collapse duration (default .4s) · curve (via style)

from.where: shared.css .rw-anim-parent .rw-logo (original c-logo01__parent.is-animated .c-logo01 svg — loader·Hero·Footer logo, seven svgs .58·.66 … 1.06s)
